title: plan_ops__plan_review_route input
description: Route Phase 1.5 / 1.5.5 plan-review state to one orchestrator directive. The CLI reads plan_review_route_input_schema.json from stdin; the MCP surface accepts that envelope under `payload` and exposes the optional `--update-schedule-state` argument as a top-level field.

payload.description: plan-review-route input envelope; conforms to plan_review_route_input_schema.json.

update_schedule_state.description: Atomically apply the emitted state_transitions block to this schedule's plan_review_state.
